$comment: MODE = light. Neutrals only: surfaces, text, borders, the decorative accent tint-surfaces (subtle) + their foregrounds, the hover shadow, and the focus ring. Brand/accent-bold colors come from the active theme via [data-theme]. Emitted under [data-mode='light'].

backdrop.comment: recessed mat behind the app frame / control tracks — a step below page

color.$comment-status: STATUS roles — success and danger. They live on the MODE axis, not the theme axis: what they mean is fixed (green is not a brand decision), but what reads on a page is not, so they carry a light and a dark value and every theme inherits both. `bg`/`fg` are the filled pair; `text` is the same status used AS TEXT, which needs its own step for the same reason text.accent does.

subtle.comment: the tint end of the pair — Badge subtle, Toast

danger.$comment: Danger splits by role. As a FILL it is caution tape — yellow ground, black label, black stripes — because a destructive control should be identifiable before the label is read. As TEXT it stays red: tape is an affordance on a control, not a way to set a sentence.

bg.comment: hazard yellow ground, carrying a black label at 12.88:1

fg.comment: black on the tape — the other half of the caution pair

text.comment: danger AS TEXT — 4.97:1 on the page, 6.27:1 on card

deep.comment: the hazard stripe on a danger control — full black on yellow, so the diagonal reads as tape rather than as texture

on-bold.comment: ink reads on the light bold hues

on-subtle.comment: ink reads on the pale subtle tints

button-lift.comment: button hover shadow — separate from card so a theme can drop it (flat) or swap it (glow)
